summary.text: Son of Hippasus, Peloponnesian Argonaut in Hyginus' roll — distinct from Actor father of Menoetius and Eurytion.

story.text: Hyginus lists Actor son of Hippasus from the Peloponnese among Jason's comrades.

The same catalogue gives only the broad region for this Actor — not a named polis. The Hippasus–Pellene link in Hyginus belongs to Asterion and Amphion (sons of Hyperasius, or alternatively of Hippasus), a separate entry in the roll; Apollodorus names Actor son of Hippasus without a town. No attested polis warrants a residence entry until a source ties this figure to a specific city.
